label: Stage-one conclusion from a finite-duration beginning with an external cause
meaning: Instantiation of the verified Arrival B (ActualEuclidean.externalNecessaryConcrete, Euclidean access at the selected world only) at the Scenario built from the history with beginning predicate BEGINS_2; the Scenario's concrete individual necessary at w is the conclusion's, with the profile's grounding relation an arbitrary parameter. A BEGINS_2 beginning with a contingent concrete individual present is a Scenario beginning; causal opportunity gives an accessible history with an existing concrete external totality-cause, necessary there by ExternalCandidateNecessity, and carried to w by Euclidean access and reflexivity at w. It puts Arrival B in a definite sense on the route to STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-AT, with B1 in that sense derivable from the metric Grim Reaper. B2 in sense BEGINS_2 does the decisive work: with B1 it already gives the possibility of a necessary concrete individual (possiblyNecessaryOfFiniteDurationOpportunity), and the Reaper premises with B1 do not reach the conclusion without it (control 2). All four premises are OPEN; no premise truth, uniqueness, causal role at w or divine attribute is established.
